objective: Reach tier A on every real Hermes Daily calibration, then pass a real-model Weekly SOP/Issue promotion proof.

baseline.reason: Fresh real-model run after identity/source repair. Documentation and knowledge are A. Memory has one real reset-safety miss. Control has one real grouping miss plus one newly discovered date-fixture inconsistency that must be corrected before refreeze.

nodes.hypothesis: Align each normal-case prompt, fixture, golden, and assertion to the same current source evidence before freezing.
nodes.expected_observation: A fresh baseline judges actual model behavior rather than stale identities or scenarios.
nodes.falsifier: Independent review still finds expected IDs, facts, or dates absent from bound inputs.
nodes.reward_basis: 2026-08-26 evidence review found fixture mismatch in project-memory and documentation-quality; current goldens confirm drift.
nodes.result: Confirmed after the date repair: all current normal-case identities, facts, dates, route facts, and expected outputs are present in their bound inputs. The corrected control case then returned A with truthful 4/6 elapsed-day arithmetic.

nodes.hypothesis: A field-complete, source-consistent workflow exemplar plus an explicit do-not-invent gate will make knowledge capture emit every required baseline field.
nodes.expected_observation: daily-knowledge-capture judge returns A without unsupported steps or systems.
nodes.falsifier: Output remains incomplete or invents workflow facts on the repaired fixture.
nodes.expected_reward: Tier A for the user-critical workflow discovery path
nodes.reward_basis: The B result passed four of six assertions and missed explicit field rendering and source IDs.
nodes.result: Confirmed: real judge returned A with 6/6 assertions met.

nodes.hypothesis: A current-context golden and explicit no-reset behavior will remove stale scenario failures while preserving minimal patches.
nodes.falsifier: The repaired model output still omits source-grounded impact/review gaps or resets attention without authority.
nodes.reward_basis: The prior B output already rendered actionable rows; its three misses referenced absent stale-fixture facts.
nodes.result: Confirmed in Round 2: real judge returned A with 5/5 assertions met after false-reset rejection and claim-level source specificity.

nodes.hypothesis: A current-context golden and assertions will test precise mapped gaps rather than obsolete SRC identities.
nodes.expected_observation: daily-documentation-quality produces only current source-linked requests and reaches A.
nodes.falsifier: It requests non-material or unmapped fields after fixture repair.
nodes.reward_basis: The C tie was entirely dominated by stale fixture expectations.
nodes.result: Confirmed: real judge returned A with 5/5 assertions met.

nodes.hypothesis: The already-updated CMT eval and golden will make the next run preserve the sourced MYR 360 calculation and Aisha route.
nodes.expected_observation: daily-project-control returns A without further instruction edits.
nodes.falsifier: The model still omits the visible cost formula or selects the wrong owner/route.

nodes.hypothesis: Correcting the control date expectation to the context's Aug 24 clock and enforcing one grouped proposal per person will produce a truthful A output.
nodes.expected_observation: daily-project-control returns A with 4 days overdue, 6 days since update, the MYR 360 formula, and one Aisha proposal covering every selected finding.
nodes.falsifier: The output still emits multiple same-person proposals, loses a finding, or misstates grounded duration/cost.
nodes.expected_reward: Tier A control behavior without false arithmetic
nodes.reward_basis: Fresh judge found the candidate otherwise met 4/6 assertions; one miss is invalid fixture arithmetic and one is a concrete grouping defect.
nodes.result: Confirmed: after correcting the invalid date expectation and enforcing per-person grouping, the real judge returned A with 6/6 assertions met.

nodes.hypothesis: A qualified Draft-backed workflow should promote to the existing SOPs surface, while a material measured problem should promote to the existing Work surface as an Issue and weaker workflow evidence should remain project_only.
nodes.expected_observation: Weekly real judge returns A across destination, baseline integrity, SOP reconstruction, retain control, hierarchy, and no-provider-effect assertions.
nodes.falsifier: Wrong destination, incomplete Before/SOP record, premature weak-candidate promotion, missing hierarchy traceability, or provider-effect claim.
nodes.expected_reward: Real proof of the user's workflow-to-paid-problem system
nodes.reward_basis: Weekly promotion is the terminal conversion from Daily observations into durable SOP and Issue records.
nodes.result: Confirmed: real judge returned A with 6/6 assertions met. TASK-203 routes to kamdar-employee-sop@1.0.0, TASK-101 routes to kamdar-issue@1.0.0 with preserved Before economics, and TASK-201 remains project_only.
